name: Wayne State University
header:
Wayne State University
United States · Mathematics PhD; MS pathway may be necessary
Roster and rank verification handled separately
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Direct PhD eligibility from UChicago bachelor’s requires equivalence or exceptional-ability approval.
• This dossier has substantial unresolved logistics due to inaccessible official department/central pages.
• Do not mistake generic June 1 or scholarship March 10 for mathematics assistantship priority.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
The current Mathematics PhD catalog requires a mathematics master's degree or equivalent level of
advancement, with possible Graduate Committee exceptions for unusual ability. A UChicago bachelor's alone
does not establish automatic direct-PhD eligibility; assess advanced coursework/equivalence and obtain
program confirmation. The M.S. is a distinct published route; the Mathematics M.A. has an admissions
moratorium in the current catalog. [s1] [s3] [s13] [qbd3_d1] [qbd3_d4] [qbd3_d5]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Obtain graduate committee guidance on direct PhD eligibility versus MS before choosing program. Prepare SOP
and three letters. Request the actual math funding/application deadline from department (catalog office phone
313-577-2479). Department and central admissions webpages were repeatedly inaccessible in this research;
unresolved fields must be checked directly. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
First contact graduate committee about degree eligibility and funding. Current faculty catalog lists
Makar-Limanov, Umirbaev, Salch and Isaksen; paper evidence below supports specific
algebraic/geometry-adjacent areas. Availability to advise in 2027 is unconfirmed. [s1] [s6] [s7] [s8] [s9] [s10]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Public Slate portal offers applications by entry term and a separate Graduate Professional Scholarship
application. Detailed referee/help mechanics are not public in the retrieved landing page. [s4]
Cycle verification [Unresolved]
2026-27 catalog is current; 2027-28 scholarship deadline is explicit. Exact Fall 2027 mathematics
admissions/funding details remain unresolved because key department/central sites were inaccessible. [s1] [s2]
[s4]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Unresolved]
No exact Mathematics PhD Fall 2027 deadline was established from the current catalog, public graduate portal
or indexed official announcements. The Mathematics PhD catalog specifies fall-only admission but no deadline.
The central June 1 date is a general latest recommended processing date and explicitly warns that doctoral
programs have earlier deadlines; it is not a verified Mathematics PhD deadline. [s1] [s2] [qbd3_d1] [qbd3_d2]
[qbd3_d3]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
2027-28 Graduate Professional Scholarship portal deadline: March 10, 2027, 11:59 EST, including all

supporting materials. This is NOT established as the mathematics assistantship deadline; scholarship eligibility
for this F-1 PhD applicant also remains unverified. [s4]
Reference receipt; Test-score receipt [Unresolved]
No separate math recommendation or score deadline established. Complete international files are required at
least four months before term, with potentially earlier doctoral deadlines; ask the department for the actual
complete-file date. [s2]
Supporting documents [Unresolved]
The central catalog requires international applications and all transcripts/documents at least four months
before term starts, while expressly warning that doctoral programs have earlier deadlines. This is a general
processing rule, not an exact Math PhD supporting-document deadline. The program-specific date remains
unverified. [s1] [s2] [qbd3_d2]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Catalog allows a completed accredited US bachelor’s or degree from a native-English country to meet English
proficiency, otherwise acceptable MELAB/TOEFL or equivalent IELTS/PTE. Current numerical minimums were
not established from accessible central sources. [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A completed accredited UChicago bachelor’s meets the catalog’s explicit US-degree route. In-progress-degree
treatment and waiver processing are not specified; confirm if applying before graduation. [s2]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
Mathematics catalog does not state a GRE policy; department admissions pages could not be retrieved.
Absence from the catalog is not evidence of waiver. Confirm General and Math Subject requirements
separately. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage; Years of support; International eligibility; Extra funding application
[Unresolved]
A mathematics-specific stipend, paid months, tuition/fees/insurance package, guaranteed duration, F-1
eligibility and separate funding-application requirement could not be established from accessible sources. Do
not apply the School of Medicine’s published stipend to mathematics. Request a written mathematics package.
[s1] [s2] [s4]
Conditions and duties [Unresolved]
For international GTAs, catalog says native non-English speakers must pass SPEAK with ≥50/60 before
teaching. Degree-based admission English exemption is not a stated GTA exemption. Mathematics-specific
workload/progress conditions remain unverified. [s5]
Other funding routes [Unresolved]
Graduate Professional Scholarship has an explicit March 10, 2027 deadline in the funding portal, but benefit
amount, PhD/F-1 eligibility and required essays/references must be checked before relying on it. [s4]
Application fee [Unresolved]
A current mathematics/central graduate fee amount was not established. Historical official material mentions
$50, but that is not verified for the 2026-27 application cycle. [s2]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
An official Wayne department FAQ directs graduate fee-waiver requests to central eligibility guidance and
gradadmissions@wayne.edu. Central eligibility page was inaccessible; F-1 eligibility and documentation
requirements remain unresolved. [s12]

than general graduate bachelor’s minimum. Math MA moratorium does not mean Math MS or PhD is closed. [s1]
[s2] [s3] [s13]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]

academic/funding/reference/document deadlines. The public catalog links to clas.wayne.edu/math/admissions,
which returned502 in this audit. The public portal's March 10, 2027 Graduate Professional Scholarship deadline

was not established in this deadline audit. [s1] [s2] [s4] [qbd3_d1] [qbd3_d2] [qbd3_d3] [qbd3_d6]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
1. Affine algebraic geometry
Leonid Makar-Limanov
Polynomial automorphisms, Jacobian conjecture and affine algebraic structures. [s6] [s7]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2025 · On the shape of a counterexample to the two-dimensional Jacobian conjecture
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
2. Algebra / automorphism groups
Ualbai Umirbaev
Automorphisms and derivations of polynomial, free and Lie algebras; connections to affine algebraic geometry.
[s6] [s8]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2026 · Automorphisms of free metabelian Lie algebras, I
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
3. Arithmetic-related homotopy / algebra
Andrew Salch
Formal groups and chromatic homotopy; recent paper studies spin-c cobordism. This is adjacent to arithmetic
geometry rather than a conventional arithmetic-geometry group. [s6] [s9]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2025 · Products in Spinc-Cobordism
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
4. Motivic homotopy
Daniel C. Isaksen
Motivic and classical stable homotopy computations; adjacent to algebraic geometry. [s6] [s10]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.

Research evidence: 2025 online / 2026 volume · Classical Stable Homotopy Groups of Spheres via F2-Synthetic Methods
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.

United States · Mathematics PhD; MS pathway may be necessary

Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Direct PhD eligibility from UChicago bachelor’s requires equivalence or exceptional-ability approval.
• This dossier has substantial unresolved logistics due to inaccessible official department/central pages.
• Do not mistake generic June 1 or scholarship March 10 for mathematics assistantship priority.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
The current Mathematics PhD catalog requires a mathematics master's degree or equivalent level of
advancement, with possible Graduate Committee exceptions for unusual ability. A UChicago bachelor's alone
does not establish automatic direct-PhD eligibility; assess advanced coursework/equivalence and obtain
program confirmation. The M.S. is a distinct published route; the Mathematics M.A. has an admissions
moratorium in the current catalog. [s1] [s3] [s13] [qbd3_d1] [qbd3_d4] [qbd3_d5]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Obtain graduate committee guidance on direct PhD eligibility versus MS before choosing program. Prepare SOP
and three letters. Request the actual math funding/application deadline from department (catalog office phone
313-577-2479). Department and central admissions webpages were repeatedly inaccessible in this research;
unresolved fields must be checked directly. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
First contact graduate committee about degree eligibility and funding. Current faculty catalog lists
Makar-Limanov, Umirbaev, Salch and Isaksen; paper evidence below supports specific
algebraic/geometry-adjacent areas. Availability to advise in 2027 is unconfirmed. [s1] [s6] [s7] [s8] [s9] [s10]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Public Slate portal offers applications by entry term and a separate Graduate Professional Scholarship
application. Detailed referee/help mechanics are not public in the retrieved landing page. [s4]
Cycle verification [Unresolved]
2026-27 catalog is current; 2027-28 scholarship deadline is explicit. Exact Fall 2027 mathematics
admissions/funding details remain unresolved because key department/central sites were inaccessible. [s1] [s2]
[s4]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application [Unresolved]
No exact Mathematics PhD Fall 2027 deadline was established from the current catalog, public graduate portal
or indexed official announcements. The Mathematics PhD catalog specifies fall-only admission but no deadline.
The central June 1 date is a general latest recommended processing date and explicitly warns that doctoral
programs have earlier deadlines; it is not a verified Mathematics PhD deadline. [s1] [s2] [qbd3_d1] [qbd3_d2]
[qbd3_d3]

Reference receipt; Test-score receipt [Unresolved]
No separate math recommendation or score deadline established. Complete international files are required at
least four months before term, with potentially earlier doctoral deadlines; ask the department for the actual
complete-file date. [s2]
Supporting documents [Unresolved]
The central catalog requires international applications and all transcripts/documents at least four months
before term starts, while expressly warning that doctoral programs have earlier deadlines. This is a general
processing rule, not an exact Math PhD supporting-document deadline. The program-specific date remains
unverified. [s1] [s2] [qbd3_d2]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Catalog allows a completed accredited US bachelor’s or degree from a native-English country to meet English
proficiency, otherwise acceptable MELAB/TOEFL or equivalent IELTS/PTE. Current numerical minimums were
not established from accessible central sources. [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A completed accredited UChicago bachelor’s meets the catalog’s explicit US-degree route. In-progress-degree
treatment and waiver processing are not specified; confirm if applying before graduation. [s2]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
Mathematics catalog does not state a GRE policy; department admissions pages could not be retrieved.
Absence from the catalog is not evidence of waiver. Confirm General and Math Subject requirements
separately. [s1] [s2]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Central catalog requests official transcript from each institution awarding a bachelor’s, sent directly by the
institution with official seal; international applicants may need more documentation. Full mathematics
transcript scope, unofficial-upload allowance and additional course records are not established. [s2]
Mathematics-course list; Course descriptions [Unresolved]
Not specified in the accessible mathematics PhD catalog. Department admissions website was inaccessible, so
this is unresolved rather than confirmation that the item is unnecessary. [s1]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three letters required for Mathematics PhD. Letter-source restrictions are not specified in the accessible
catalog. [s1]
Scholarship references; What sends the invitation; Before versus after submission; Receipt
confirmation; Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Public accessible mathematics catalog and funding portal do not establish scholarship-specific references,
invitation timing, post-submission invitation behavior, receipt confirmation, replacement or reuse. Request
current Slate instructions; do not import another department’s rules. [s1] [s4]

proposal; Writing sample / thesis / research summary; Publications list; Course-list document;
Scholarship essays; Other short answers / materials [Unresolved]
Not specified in the accessible mathematics PhD catalog. Department admissions website was inaccessible, so
this is unresolved rather than confirmation that the item is unnecessary. [s1]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Statement of purpose required. Exact prompt, word/page limit, formatting, upload/link rule and whether
research interests should be separately stated are not published in the accessible catalog. [s1]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage; Years of support; International eligibility; Extra funding application
[Unresolved]
A mathematics-specific stipend, paid months, tuition/fees/insurance package, guaranteed duration, F-1
eligibility and separate funding-application requirement could not be established from accessible sources. Do
not apply the School of Medicine’s published stipend to mathematics. Request a written mathematics package.
[s1] [s2] [s4]
Conditions and duties [Unresolved]
For international GTAs, catalog says native non-English speakers must pass SPEAK with ≥50/60 before
teaching. Degree-based admission English exemption is not a stated GTA exemption. Mathematics-specific
workload/progress conditions remain unverified. [s5]
Other funding routes [Unresolved]
Graduate Professional Scholarship has an explicit March 10, 2027 deadline in the funding portal, but benefit
amount, PhD/F-1 eligibility and required essays/references must be checked before relying on it. [s4]
Application fee [Unresolved]
A current mathematics/central graduate fee amount was not established. Historical official material mentions
$50, but that is not verified for the 2026-27 application cycle. [s2]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
An official Wayne department FAQ directs graduate fee-waiver requests to central eligibility guidance and
gradadmissions@wayne.edu. Central eligibility page was inaccessible; F-1 eligibility and documentation
requirements remain unresolved. [s12]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Standing rule]
No claim that bachelor’s automatically qualifies: mathematics master’s/equivalence requirement is stricter
than general graduate bachelor’s minimum. Math MA moratorium does not mean Math MS or PhD is closed. [s1]
[s2] [s3] [s13]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Ask mathgrad@wayne.edu to confirm direct-PhD eligibility and the Fall 2027
academic/funding/reference/document deadlines. The public catalog links to clas.wayne.edu/math/admissions,
which returned502 in this audit. The public portal's March 10, 2027 Graduate Professional Scholarship deadline
is for that named award and must not be substituted for the Math PhD application deadline; award eligibility
was not established in this deadline audit. [s1] [s2] [s4] [qbd3_d1] [qbd3_d2] [qbd3_d3] [qbd3_d6]
